key_findings: Alcohol withdrawal induces mechanical but not thermal hypersensitivity at 72 h in mice, reversed by MAGL inhibitor JZL184 via CB1 and CB2.
DAGL inhibition or CB1/CB2 blockade exacerbates and prolongs withdrawal hypersensitivity.
